key_insight: A helical pipe passively homogenizes pneumatic particle transport by inducing swirl that redistributes particles across the cross-section and narrows velocity differences.
engineering_relevance: This offers a geometry-based way to improve conveying uniformity at moderate gas velocities without increasing energy input or relying on active controls.
method: CFD-DEM simulations compare straight and helical pipe geometries.
The helical shape generates swirling gas and particle motion.
Cross-sectional mixing continuously redistributes particles during transport.
evidence_signal: Simulation results in the abstract show the helical pipe transforms strongly heterogeneous transport into a more homogeneous state with a narrower particle-velocity distribution.
watch_item: Performance may depend on pipe geometry and operating conditions, so pressure drop, wear, and scalability should be checked before deployment.
paper_title: Helical pipes homogenize particle transport in pneumatic conveying
